data.content_ref: inline:conn:204d29004328 REDUCES TO the CRT formula construction in SRC_004: any correct solution to x≡3 mod 5, x≡4 mod 7 can be obtained by evaluating the CRT expression x = 3·(7·3) + 4·(5·3) mod 35 = 123 mod 35 = 18. The successive-enumeration method of SRC_005 is a special case that searches the residue class produced by CRT without constructing it explicitly. This reduction is REFUTED IF there exists a solution to the congruence system that the CRT formula cannot produce, or if the CRT formula requires computing a modular inverse that fails (e.g., gcd(5,7)≠1).
